_doc: Reviewed-OK allowlist for book_purity.py — iaiyh (audited 2026-07-02). spell_ok = domain terms / proper nouns / citation sources confirmed legit (not OCR typos). reviewed_ok = non-spell keeps (real hyphenated compounds, legit alphanumerics). Genuine unresolved issues are EXCLUDED so the scan stays loud until fixed. 2026-08-03: 'anes' REMOVED — it existed only because OCR split NHANES into 'NH ANES'; the split is fixed, so the carve-out was a claim about the world that had stopped being true. 'nhanes' + 'iii' ADDED 2026-08-03 with the NH-ANES fix: both are real terms the speller does not know (NHANES = National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey; III = roman three, already allowlisted in dddl's baseline alongside iaiyh's existing vii/viii/xiii). The gate reddened on the CORRECTION, not a defect — it had been green because 'anes'/'Il'/'Ill' were blessed.
